recipes.name: Easy Black Beans and Rice
ingredients_raw: 1 (15.5 ounce) can Goya Black Beans, undrained
1 tablespoon Goya Extra Virgin Olive Oil
0.5 teaspoon Goya Oregano Leaf, or to taste
0.25 teaspoon Goya Cumin, or to taste
Goya Adobo with Pepper, to taste
2 cups cooked Canilla Extra Long Grain Rice

steps.text: Add 1/4 cup water to 4 quart saucepan over medium heat. Add first 10 ingredients to pot. Bring bean mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until flavors come together, about 10 minutes. Discard bay leaf; season beans with Adobo.
Divide beans evenly among serving plates. Divide cooked rice evenly among plates alongside beans.

raw_recipe.headline: Easy Black Beans and Rice
raw_recipe.description: Black Beans and Rice is the perfect family side dish. It's fast and affordable, and everyone loves the taste. A black bean and rice dish is more than satisfying, too--it's packed with protein for a healthy meal. Our recipe for rice and beans can't be easier. You make it with GOYA® Canned Beans, so you won't mind when your family requests it again and again.

review.reviewBody: I enjoy the Goya products.. For an easy recipe.. look on the label of Goya Black Beans. I use some green pepper, onion - sauteed in olive oil till tender, 1 can black beans, 1 package of Goya Sazon seasoning and a touch of Goya Adobe seasoning. Simple and Awesome..
Yes.. First purchased my beans from "Rancho Gordo".. And the bean in question is "Rio Zape"... The rice is "Basmati Long grain Brown".. Google them,,,,, YOU'LL NEVER purchase from the store again!!
I made this with 1/2 cup black beans to 1 cup brown rice. I also covered the dish with a little strawberry vinegrette.
Simple & just what I was craving. I used "no salt added" can of black beans. I used cooking sherry since it's what I had on hand. Taste great with garlic, chicken broth basmati rice!

We really liked this dish. I paired it with grilled chicken rather than making it a main dish alone. The beans were very very flavorful, but I couldn't help myself...I did drain and rinse the beans. The liquid they're in just seems too gooey to me. I used buttered jasmine rice with the beans, and it was a meal we'll definitely repeat. Also I had to leave out the recaito because my husband and I both have those weird taste buds that make cilantro taste like soap. Nevertheless, the beans were still perfect for us. Thanks, Goya!

I added extra garlic to mine. I also lightly rinsed my beans and added salted chicken broth instead of the wine. For my rice, I used Goya yellow rice. It was a simple meal and great addition to our Mexican night at home.
We leave out the olive oil to make a fat free beans and rice and use brown rice rather than white. Quick and easy alternative to boiling dried beans or using a slow cooker.
First time making this recipe, everyone enjoyed them. I didn’t have recaito so I made without...very good.
Rice and pork chops on side.... Amazingly good

Black Beans & Rice Haiku: "I LOVE Goya stuff. Didn't have the Recaito, so used cilantro." I used just about all of the Goya products called for in the ingredient list other than the Recaito which I didn't have, so I tossed in a handful of chopped cilantro. Really great stuff - incredibly easy to put together and delicious over rice.
Very easy. Had all ingredients on hand. Made with Salsa Chicken recipe from this site and rice.

Nothing out of this world or rocking my socks off, but it was good paired with the (amazing) Goya fajita recipe. I am pretty sure this is a personal preference; usually my beans are mashed and refried! I may try making some black refried beans next time.

A good tasting recipe I made my own Sazon seasoning and Jasmine rice and paired this combo off with a good steak and salad. I had a happy well fed husband at the end of the meal and a request to keep this dinner in the monthly line up.
